public_target: Rbar, the reduction of supplied exact rational R; rho receives this same public point; R is a supplied target lift and its acquisition is outside both timed intervals
collision_arm: fresh height-ordered scan of nonzero aQ+bR, reducing each rational point; first nonzero reduction collision or zero reduction with nonzero b difference yields lambda by modular division; stop only after lambda*Qbar=Rbar verification
rho_arm: pinned deterministic three-partition Floyd rho from source_rho_solver, solving the same Rbar target with a new hashed seed per repetition
arm_order: collision then rho on odd one-based repetitions; rho then collision on even repetitions
online_interval: start before first target-dependent rational construction or rho walk; stop after lambda recovery and independent public-point verification; include failed attempts/restarts; exclude checked-runtime startup, curve/pairing/order setup and construction of supplied rational R
status_policy: retain verified, coefficient_cap_exhausted, rho_cap_exhausted, wall_cap_exhausted and error rows, including censored intervals and work counters
claim_boundary: repeated special-target ordinary-host component diagnostic with supplied rational target lift; no inference for arbitrary public target or Tier 0/1 speedup
